notes: GeoTalk 1.10: calls now have to prove they carry real sound. On some phones the first connection path reported itself connected yet carried no voice at all — the person who placed the call heard silence, and the call simply stayed on that silent path. The app now measures the actual voice packets on a connected call: if the first path connects but no voice has arrived within about eight seconds, the app automatically switches the call to the proven direct engine instead of staying silent, and a path that connected without carrying voice no longer counts as the remembered good path — the app remembers the path that actually carried your voice. Every internet call now also records its voice-packet counts (received and sent) into the problem report, whichever engine carried it, so any remaining audio problem can be pinpointed exactly instead of guessed at. Everything from 1.9 is kept in full: the one-way-audio fixes for direct calls (connection addresses refreshed at the moment a call connects, the voice path chosen and held by real voice rather than test pings, looped-back copies of your own voice recognised and dropped, direct local path when both phones share one connection), call-back by tapping any entry in the Calls tab, the complete 1.7 feature set with the 1.7 launch problem fixed — push starts safely after the app opens and can never block or break it, faster calls via the remembered proven path and ringing-time connection preparation, Opus HD voice (wideband 16 kHz, adaptive about 16–40 kbps with error correction) that stays clear on slow connections at roughly a tenth of the data, push incoming calls with the full call screen even when the app is closed (this activates as soon as the push service is switched on for your account — no app update will be needed after that), the independent direct-UDP live voice engine between WebRTC and Push-to-Talk, native crash details in problem reports, the call safety guard that resets on every new version, call signaling on its own dedicated thread, proper telephony audio mode with audio focus, incoming calls ring with your default ringtone and vibration, direct phone-to-phone WebRTC voice first, Cloudflare TURN relay (UDP, TCP and TLS 443) when a network blocks the direct path, Push-to-Talk as the final fallback, plus internet and Bluetooth chat + voice calls, voice messages and in-app updates.
